assignments.reason: Intellectual contemplation of God's greatness and exaltedness (התבוננות השכל בגדלתו ורוממותו) is the cognitive engagement of the sekhel directed toward the Divine. Its essential nature is sekhel-in-action — the same intellect (שכל/יוד) that forms the upper point of the letter alef. The Torah states: 'יִרְאָה הָרִאשׁוֹנָה שֶׁהִיא עַל יְדֵי הִתְבּוֹנְנוּת הַשֵּׂכֶל בִּגְדֻלָּתוֹ וְרוֹמְמוּתוֹ' — this contemplation is the activation of the yud/sekhel that generates the upper yir'ah. While it CAUSES yir'ah (eitza edge 1411), its essential nature IS sekhel applied to divine greatness, placing it squarely in the domain of intellect and fear of God that constitutes Package 1.

The mist (אד) is explicitly identified in the source text as the essential nature of the lower yir'ah: 'הַיִּרְאָה הַשְּׁנִיָּה... הִיא בְּחִינַת אד' — the second fear IS the bechina of 'ed' (mist). The Torah further links this to the verse 'וְאֵד יַעֲלֶה מִן הָאָרֶץ' (Genesis 2:6). The mist is not a separate domain — it IS the lower yir'ah in its metaphysical garment, the mechanism of raising feminine waters (העלאת מיין נוקבין). As a bechina of yir'ah tachtonah, its essential nature belongs to the yir'ah domain. It is positive — a valid path to God-consciousness through lower-grade fear that still draws down divine abundance.

assignments.node_id: "והשקה את כל פני האדמה", כי על ידה נמשכין השפעות
assignments.reason: The watering of the earth / drawing down of divine abundance ('וְהִשְׁקָה אֶת כָּל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה, כִּי עַל יָדָהּ נִמְשָׁכִין הַשְׁפָּעוֹת') is the Scriptural expression for the function of the lower yir'ah. Its essential nature is the positive divine flow (hashpa'ot) that descends when the mist of lower fear rises. In the Torah's conceptual architecture, this is the completed action of the yir'ah-system: the alef structure (upper yir'ah) completes God's Name, while the lower yir'ah (אד) draws down sustenance. This node represents the beneficial, holy flow of abundance — an integral part of the yir'ah domain, not a separate conceptual territory. It is unambiguously positive: divine blessings flowing into the world through fear of God.
